### 1. LAYOUT
*   **Window Bounds:** 1024x768 (Maximized, excluding Windows taskbar).
*   **Title Bar (0, 0) – (1024, 45):** Contains app icon/title (left), utility icons (center-right), and window controls (far right).
*   **Sidebar (Left Pane):** (0, 46) – (280, 930). Vertical navigation list.
    *   **Section: Data Recovery:** (10, 95) – (270, 195). Contains "Hardware Disk" (selected), "SD Card", "More Recovery Tools".
    *   **Section: Advanced Features:** (10, 375) – (270, 525). Contains "File Repair", "Lost Partition Rescue".
    *   **Section: File Backup:** (10, 570) – (270, 660). Contains "ChronoSnap Backup".
*   **Main Content Area (Right Pane):** (281, 46) – (1024, 930). Light gray/white background.
    *   **Header:** (310, 110) – (680, 155). Title text and refresh icon.
    *   **Internal Drives Section:** (310, 195) – (850, 370). Grid of 2 drive tiles.
    *   **Specify a Location Section:** (310, 405) – (700, 700). List of location cards (Recycle Bin, Desktop, Select Folder).
    *   **Footer Bar:** (281, 840) – (1024, 930). Contains help text (left) and primary CTA button (right).

### 2. TEXT (Verbatim)
*   **Title Bar:** `EaseUS Data Recovery Wizard Free`
*   **Sidebar Headers:** `Data Recovery`, `Advanced Features`, `File Backup`
*   **Sidebar Items:** `Hardware Disk`, `SD Card`, `More Recovery Tools`, `File Repair`, `Lost Partition Rescue`, `ChronoSnap Backup`
*   **Main Header:** `Select a location to search for lost data`
*   **Subheader:** `Internal drives (2)`
*   **Drive Tile 1:** `Windows(C:)`, `31.15 GB/149.45 GB`
*   **Drive Tile 2:** `Temporary Storage(D:)`, `146.12 GB/150 GB`
*   **Location Subheader:** `Specify a location`
*   **Location Items:** `Recycle Bin`, `Desktop`, `Select Folder`
*   **Footer Text:** `Unable to find your hard drive?`
*   **Button Text:** `Search for Lost Data`

### 3. COLOR (Estimated Hex)
*   **Backgrounds:**
    *   Sidebar Background: `#F5F8FC` (Very light blue-gray)
    *   Main Area Background: `#FFFFFF` (White)
    *   Selected Sidebar Item: `#E1EFFF` (Light blue highlight)
    *   Selected Drive Tile Border/BG: `#2B85FF` (Blue border), `#FFFFFF` (Fill)
*   **Text:**
    *   Primary Text (Titles/Names): `#1F2329` (Near black)
    *   Secondary Text (Sizes/Captions): `#666666` or `#888888` (Gray)
    *   Selected Text: `#2B85FF` (Blue)
*   **Accents & Controls:**
    *   Primary Button (Search): `#2B85FF` (Solid Blue)
    *   Progress Bar (Used Space - C:): `#2B85FF`
    *   Progress Bar (Used Space - D:): `#A6C4FF` or similar lighter blue/gray
    *   Checkmark Icon: `#2B85FF`
    *   Success Badge (Green check): `#52C41A`
*   **Borders/Separators:**
    *   Tile Borders (Unselected): `#E0E0E0` (Light Gray)

### 4. TYPOGRAPHY
*   **Window Title:** Segoe UI / System Font, ~9-10px, Regular.
*   **Sidebar Headers:** Segoe UI, ~11-12px, Regular, Dark Gray.
*   **Sidebar Items (Selected):** Segoe UI, ~13px, Semi-bold/Medium, Blue/Dark.
*   **Main Heading ("Select a location..."):** Segoe UI, ~20-22px, Regular (or slightly Medium), Black.
*   **Subheadings ("Internal drives...", "Specify..."):** Segoe UI, ~13-14px, Regular, Gray.
*   **Tile Titles ("Windows(C:)", "Recycle Bin"):** Segoe UI, ~14-15px, Regular/Medium, Black.
*   **Tile Stats ("31.15 GB..."):** Segoe UI, ~11-12px, Regular, Gray.
*   **Button Text:** Segoe UI, ~14px, Medium, White.

### 5. SPACING & SIZING
*   **Sidebar Width:** ~280px.
*   **Sidebar Item Height:** ~48px.
*   **Sidebar Icon Size:** 24x24px (approx).
*   **Tile Dimensions (Drives):** Width ~240px, Height ~120px. Border Radius: ~6-8px. Border Width: 2px (when selected), 1px (normal).
*   **Tile Padding:** Internal padding ~16px.
*   **Icon Size (Tiles):** 48x48px or 64x64px (Large illustrative icons).
*   **Progress Bar Height:** ~4-6px. Radius: ~2px (pill shape).
*   **Primary Button:** Height ~44px. Width ~200px. Border Radius: ~6px. Padding Horizontal ~24px.
*   **Gutters:**
    *   Between Sidebar and Main: ~0px (adjacent, separated by border/color change).
    *   Between Tiles (Horizontal): ~40px.
    *   Between Sections (Vertical): ~30-40px.

### 6. CONTROLS & STATES
*   **Sidebar List Item (`Hardware Disk`):** State = **Selected**. Indicator = Blue left border strip + Blue background + Green checkmark badge on right.
*   **Sidebar List Item (`SD Card`, etc.):** State = **Normal**.
*   **Drive Tile (`Windows(C:)`):** State = **Selected/Focused**. Indicator = Blue border (2px), Blue checkmark icon in top-right corner.
*   **Drive Tile (`Temporary Storage(D:)`):** State = **Normal**. Indicator = Light gray border (1px).
*   **Location Cards (`Recycle Bin`, etc.):** State = **Normal** (Clickable cards, no visible selection state in this view).
*   **Primary Button (`Search for Lost Data`):** State = **Normal/Enabled**. Solid blue background, white text.
*   **Refresh Icon (next to header):** Circular hover target implied, currently static.

### 7. ICONOGRAPHY
*   **Style:** Flat, filled, with subtle gradients/shading (Microsoft Fluent style). Rounded corners on square icons.
*   **Grid:** Aligned to left within sidebar items and tiles.
*   **Specifics:**
    *   **App Icon:** Blue square with white abstract shape.
    *   **Hardware Disk:** Blue grid/window pane icon.
    *   **SD Card:** Gray SD card shape.
    *   **More Recovery Tools:** Wrench/Screwdriver crossed.
    *   **File Repair:** Document with wrench/magic wand.
    *   **Lost Partition Rescue:** Hard drive with circular arrow/search.
    *   **ChronoSnap Backup:** Circular arrow (refresh/sync style).
    *   **Drive Icons:** Realistic isometric illustrations of HDD/SSD.
    *   **Recycle Bin:** Standard bin icon with refresh arrow.
    *   **Desktop:** Monitor screen icon.
    *   **Select Folder:** Yellow/Manila folder icon.

### 8. STATE
*   **Page State:** **Initial / Selection Required**. The user is at the first step of the wizard ("Select a location"). No data is loading (no spinners on content), but the header has a refresh icon implying data can be refreshed.
*   **Selection State:** The "Hardware Disk" category is active, and specifically the "Windows(C:)" drive is pre-selected or user-selected.
*   **System State:** Windows 11 environment (centered taskbar icons, rounded corners on windows). Date visible: 10/17/2026.
